model_conventions.formal_meaning: Languages and repositories are arbitrary finite Lean types; counts are finite sums of zero-one natural-number indicators.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source uses finite indexed sums but leaves the carrier implementation implicit.

model_conventions.formal_meaning: The conditional CDF is represented as a continuous monotone real function; the formalization proves nonnegative threshold differences, not a conditional-measure identity.
model_conventions.why_needed: A full conditional probability space and CDF construction are outside the selected finite order-theoretic scope.

checked_proof_steps.source_step: The maximum over the expanded menu weakly exceeds the maximum over the old menu, so activation indicators and their sum are weakly larger.
When the delegation threshold is below the solo threshold, the indicators differ exactly on the half-open interval between them.
checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: Exact natural-number indicator identity and nonnegative summed CDF difference.

checked_proof_steps.source_step: Ordered hazards reverse the no-use bases, natural powers preserve the order, and first differences equal p times the surviving at-risk probability.
checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: Weak nonnegativity on the closed unit interval and strict dynamics on its interior.

checked_proof_steps.source_step: A finite sum of a common activation increment equals candidate count times that increment; the product is monotone in nonnegative factors.
Weakly lower entry costs weakly increase every repository indicator; a strict band witness makes the sum strictly larger.
checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: Weak and strict finite repository-count expansion.

defects.source_locator: PDF p. 15, Proposition 3; PDF p. 62, Appendix A.6 after Equation (27)
defects.source_claim: In the closed-frontier benchmark p1 = 0 < p2, the cumulative effect is strictly increasing and concave over the observed horizon.
defects.repair_obligation: Add p2 < 1 to the strict-growth and strict-concavity clause, or weaken strict inequalities at p2 = 1.
defects.acceptance_condition: Prove the corrected interior theorem and prove that strict growth fails at the endpoint p2 = 1.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The Lean endpoint is narrower than the printed strict clause because it adds the necessary upper-bound assumption p2 < 1.
